2026 YouGo Games

Memories of War

Hired as the programmer, ended up fixing the design

  • RoleGame Designer · Sole Developer
  • Team5–6
  • TimelineContract project
  • StatusReleased
  • Built withUnity · C#
Play in browser on itch.io

The project

A squad-based grid tactics game built around a shared action economy, chess-inspired movement and meaningful positioning. I designed the levels, the obstacles and the ally and enemy stats, moved the game onto a simple low-number stat system, and developed the entire game.

What I owned

  • Level design, obstacle layout and encounter construction
  • Ally and enemy stat design
  • Moving the game to a simple, low-number stat system
  • Sole programmer — the entire build

A problem I solved

I was brought onto this as the programmer. But the problems I kept hitting while building it were not implementation problems, they were design problems — the game was harder to enjoy than it needed to be, and no amount of clean code was going to fix that.

I could have implemented the spec as handed to me and let it be someone else's issue. Instead I took it to the client, laid out what I was running into, and we worked through it together. We changed some genuinely important aspects of the game, including moving the stat system onto simple, low numbers.

Result

The changes shipped, and players have a better time with the game than they would have with the version I was originally handed. Being the person who builds it means you see the design failing before anyone else does — that is worth saying out loud rather than working around.
